question: How many Brahmā and related parts may be present in the described configuration?
premises: A configuration may have three parts beginning with Brahmā.
Alternatively it may have two or one such part.
The object is described as joined with these parts.
inference: The configuration may be joined with three, two, or one of the Brahmā and related parts.
plain_english: Joined with three parts beginning with Brahmā, or with two, or with one.
